protocol.decision: all 36 family/checkpoint comparisons must pass; no averaging away failures

costs.note: Same-checkpoint arms have equal logical budgets; later checkpoints incur extra training. Not equal CPU time. Outer comparisons reuse one task pool and Bonferroni covers all 36.

result.caveat: Public synthetic generators and seed split are not independent blind real-task evaluation. Commitment records provenance, not a causal or mathematical RSI proof.
